title: OpenGame: Open Agentic Coding for Web Games
summary: An open-source agentic framework for autonomous end-to-end web game creation using specialized LLMs. It generates fully playable 2D games from natural language prompts by integrating design, coding, and automated debugging skills.
research_notes: Developed by CUHK MMLab researchers; utilizes VLM judges for real-time playability and visual alignment verification.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026 with the GameCoder-27B model and OpenGame-Bench evaluation suite. It evolved from basic code generation to a dual-skill system (Template & Debug) using execution-grounded reinforcement learning.
